## 1. Agency Overview & Purpose
Launchpad Forge is a modern digital engineering partner that turns business concepts and manual operational bottlenecks into resilient digital experiences, custom software platforms, and event-driven automation pipelines. We build bespoke systems for founders, technical leaders, and operational organizations.

## 2. Core Service Offerings
- Website Design & High-Performance Development: Headless web applications, Next.js App Router flagships, sub-2.0s Largest Contentful Paint (LCP), and editorial brand platforms.
- Mobile Application Engineering: Cross-platform iOS and Android apps using React Native and Expo with biometrics, push notifications, and offline caching.
- AI Systems & Intelligent Integrations: Domain-specific RAG knowledge search engines, autonomous tool-calling agents, document OCR pipelines, and private cloud model deployments with zero data retention policies.
- Business Workflow Automation & APIs: Event-driven workflows using self-hosted n8n, Meta WhatsApp Cloud API automated customer qualification funnels, and resilient webhook bridges connecting CRM, billing, and databases.
- Custom Software & MVP Engineering: Full-cycle product development from relational PostgreSQL modeling to multi-tenant authentication, Stripe billing, and production deployment.
- Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps: Hardened AWS, Cloudflare, Docker containerization, CI/CD automated deployment pipelines, and uptime monitoring.

## 3. Verified Portfolio Case Studies
- Apex Fleet Dispatch System: Real-time logistics telemetry web app and mobile driver portal eliminating paper delivery manifests across 45 vehicles and reducing billing turnaround from 4 days to 15 minutes.
- OmniRAG Knowledge Copilot: Hybrid vector and keyword RAG search engine across 10,000+ technical PDF manuals, reducing maintenance query resolution time from 18 minutes to 22 seconds with 98.4% verified citation accuracy.
- Pulse Lead Automation & WhatsApp Bridge: Event-driven n8n workflow engine connected to Meta WhatsApp Cloud API reducing inbound lead response time from 3.5 hours to 28 seconds and lifting discovery call booking by 19%.
- Veloce D2C Headless Storefront: Next.js edge-rendered headless ecommerce platform cutting mobile LCP from 4.4s to 1.1s and improving checkout conversion rate by 26%.

## 4. Engineering Principles & Intellectual Property
- 100% Code Ownership: Clients own all custom source code, Figma design systems, database schemas, and infrastructure scripts upon final milestone payment.
- Strict Type Safety: Full TypeScript in strict mode, runtime Zod validation, and end-to-end typed API communication.
- No Vendor Lock-In: Clean architectural conventions with reproducible Docker and standard cloud deployment configurations.
- Direct Engineer Access: Transparent weekly sprint demos on private staging URLs with zero non-technical account manager intermediaries.
